before: Paragraph formatting other than alignment in a content lock returned success with no change or an invalid-argument code. A tracked alignment could merge into a pending paragraph change that the lock could not reject. Tracked formatting changes made during a session could not be accepted or rejected, because their logical node ids named no story part.
after: Those paragraph formats are refused with code locked before the write, and a tracked alignment that the lock could not reject is refused. Review decisions find the story part of a logical node id, so every participant can accept or reject those changes.
reason: The change adds local admission checks and a local part lookup. It adds no shared field or operation shape. Remote changes still arrive through package application, and accepted or rejected changes use the existing revision operations that every peer already applies.
